notes: Go only. Lets an editor that speaks the Agent Client Protocol (Zed and others) drive a PiG agent: the Package components/acp is a Go port of pi-acp (Sergii Kozak, MIT).

The Piglet Binary does not speak ACP by itself. ACP is JSON-RPC on stdio and a fused extension must not write protocol bytes to the host's stdout, so the entrypoint is the companion executable pig-acp, started by the editor with --pig pointing at this agent. Proven with a built Piglet Binary as the --pig target of pig-acp (11 end-to-end scenarios and the ACP reference client); there is no one-command Binary yet.

Advertised and implemented: initialize, session/new, session/load, session/list, session/delete, session/prompt with streaming text, thoughts, tool calls, diffs and terminal output, session/cancel, model and thinking-level selection, context usage, permission requests for extension select and confirm dialogs. Not supported, by design: file system and terminal delegation, MCP servers passed by the editor, extension slash commands, input and editor dialogs.

No release is published; version 0.1.0 is a development default and only linux/amd64 has been built and run; linux/arm64, darwin/arm64, darwin/amd64 and windows/amd64 are listed in the manifest and compile-checked only; neither is a support claim.
